# Project rules for GitHub Copilot

# Project overview

**study-english** — a PWA for Vietnamese learners to study English vocabulary
(flashcards, quiz, review of wrong answers). Talks to a separate backend API
(`VITE_API_URL`).

## Stack

- React 19 + TypeScript (strict) + Vite 7
- MUI v7 (`@mui/material`, `@mui/icons-material`) + Emotion
- react-router-dom v7
- vite-plugin-pwa
- Node >= 22 (see `.node-version`)

## Commands

| Task     | Command                                               |
| -------- | ----------------------------------------------------- |
| Dev      | `npm run dev`                                         |
| Build    | `npm run build` (runs `tsc -b` first — must pass)     |
| Lint     | `npm run lint`                                        |
| Format   | `npm run format` (check only: `npm run format:check`) |
| AI rules | `npm run rules:gen` after editing `.ai/rules`         |

## Before you finish a task

1. `npm run lint` and `npm run format:check` pass with no new warnings.
2. `npm run build` passes (type-check included).
3. You followed the rules in this document; when existing code disagrees
   with a rule, match the surrounding code and mention it.

There is no test runner yet. When one is added, add its command to this
checklist.

# Architecture

## Feature-based layout

```
src/
├── App.tsx              # routes only (lazy-loaded pages)
├── main.tsx             # bootstrapping, providers
├── theme.ts             # MUI theme
└── features/
    └── <feature>/
        ├── components/  # presentational UI for this feature
        ├── context/     # React context providers (if needed)
        ├── hooks/       # data + state hooks (useXxx.ts)
        ├── pages/       # route-level components (XxxPage.tsx)
        ├── services/    # API calls, storage — no React
        ├── types/       # TS types shared inside the feature
        └── utils/       # pure functions, no React, no I/O
```

- New feature → new folder under `src/features/`. Only create the
  sub-folders you need.
- Code used by 2+ features moves to `src/shared/<same sub-folders>`.

## Dependency direction

```
pages → components → hooks → services → (fetch / storage)
                       ↘ utils, types (usable from any layer)
```

- `services/` and `utils/` never import React.
- Components never call `fetch` / `api_fetch` directly — go through a hook
  or service.
- Cross-feature imports go through that feature's public pieces
  (services, hooks, types).
- Known exception: `vocabulary` imports `auth/services/apiClient`. It is
  planned to move to `src/shared/services/`; until then import it from
  `auth`, and don't add more cross-feature imports like it.

## Routing

- Every page is registered in `App.tsx` with `lazy()` + named-export remap.
- Protected pages are wrapped in `<RequireAuth>`.

# Naming

This repo uses **snake_case for values**, which differs from the usual JS
default. Follow it exactly.

| Kind                              | Style                   | Example                              |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| Variables, params, functions      | snake_case              | `topic_id`, `fetch_topic`, `give_up` |
| State setters                     | `set_` + name           | `[topic, set_topic] = useState()`    |
| Object/interface fields, props    | snake_case              | `total_words`, `on_reset`            |
| Event-handler props               | `on_` + verb            | `on_flashcards`, `on_quiz`           |
| Service objects & their methods   | snake_case              | `vocabulary_service.get_topic`       |
| React components                  | PascalCase              | `TopicCard`, `VocabularyPage`        |
| Hooks                             | camelCase `use`         | `useTopic`, `useStudyDirection`      |
| Types / interfaces                | PascalCase              | `VocabularyTopic`, `TopicCardProps`  |
| String-literal union members      | snake_case              | `'not_started' \| 'in_progress'`     |
| Module constants (true constants) | UPPER_SNAKE_CASE        | `ACCESS_TOKEN_KEY`, `EXPIRY_SKEW_MS` |
| Storage keys / custom event names | `study_english:` prefix | `'study_english:unauthorized'`       |

## Files

| Content              | File name        |
| -------------------- | ---------------- |
| Component / page     | `PascalCase.tsx` |
| Hook                 | `useXxx.ts`      |
| Service, util, types | `camelCase.ts`   |

- Pages end with `Page` (`QuizPage.tsx`); props interfaces end with `Props`.
- Booleans read as a question: `loading`, `review`, `active`, `is_*`/`has_*`.

- Hooks stay camelCase (`useXxx`) even though values are snake_case: the
  `react-hooks` ESLint plugin only recognises hooks named `use` + capital.

# TypeScript

## Types

- `strict` is on. No `any`; use `unknown` and narrow.
- Errors from `catch` are `unknown`:
  `reason instanceof Error ? reason : new Error(String(reason))`.
- Model fixed sets of values as string-literal unions, not `enum`.
- `interface` for object shapes and props; `type` for unions/aliases.
- Lookup tables: `Record<Union, Value>` so every member is covered.
- Put API/domain types in `features/<f>/types/`; keep component-only types
  (e.g. `XxxProps`) next to the component.

## Imports / exports

- **Named exports only** (`export function TopicCard`). No default exports,
  except where a tool requires one.
- Type-only imports use `import type { ... }`.
- Relative imports inside a feature; no path aliases (none configured).
- Import order: react → third-party (MUI icons, MUI, router) → local.

## Formatting

Formatting is enforced by Prettier (`.prettierrc.json`): no semicolons,
single quotes, trailing commas, 2-space indent, 80 cols. Run
`npm run format` instead of hand-formatting.

- Prefer `function` declarations for components, hooks and helpers;
  arrow functions for inline callbacks and service-object members.
- Numeric literals ≥ 1000 use separators: `10_000`.

# Git

- Never commit directly to `main`; branch as `feat/<name>`, `fix/<name>`,
  `chore/<name>`.
- Commit message: `[Tag] Short imperative summary`
  - Tags: `[Feature]`, `[Improve]`, `[Fix]`, `[Refactor]`, `[Chore]`
- One logical change per PR; lint, format:check, build and rules:check green before opening it.
- Don't commit `dist/`, `.env*` (except `.env.example`), or generated
  files you didn't regenerate with `npm run rules:gen`.
